subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age and max-turn rotation as core session lifecycle config, and what continuity or memory flush behavior must happen before rotation?
rationale: The implementation shape is source-clear, but the public config keys, defaults, and pre-rotation state-preservation contract affect session compatibility and user data expectations.

options.title: Design a unified core lifecycle policy
options.body: Add canonical session.reset age/turn triggers with durable turn accounting, pre-rotation continuity behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Defer to narrower adjacent work
options.body: Keep this issue open until token-pressure auto-split, rolling pruning, and pre-reset memory flush decisions clarify the shared lifecycle contract.

options.title: Decline new public TTL config
options.body: Document daily/idle reset, manual reset, compaction, pruning, and operational hygiene as the supported model instead of adding another session lifecycle knob.

recommendation.title: Design a unified core lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Add canonical session.reset age/turn triggers with durable turn accounting, pre-rotation continuity behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced daily reset and pre-compaction memory flush, which are the core behaviors a session rotation policy would need to coordinate.
